title: The Broken Oath
author: Petra Hartwell
blurb: Ansel Voss, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
